notes.title: Would you try version 1.00?
notes.content:
Version 1.00 is about the time the developer started making games. 
There are a lot of faults, but I made it hard.
Would you like to try it?

Right-click the game name in the STEAM app.
Under Properties, click the Beta tab.
Select version 1.00 from the drop-down list.
To undo, select "None. not participate in any beta".

Thank you for your playing!
(Note that the STEAM achievements are shared by both versions.)

notes.title: Fixed Enemy AI
notes.content:
While repeating the update, it seems AI of enemy fighters has become strange somehow. I fixed the AI of the enemy fighter. I think it probably got better.
We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Supported multiple languages.
notes.content: Supported Finnish, Danish, Traditional Chinese, and Norwegian.

notes.title: Added extra level 2.
notes.content:
Added extra level 2.
Added "STEAM Achievement" of extra level and extra level 2.

notes.title: Supported multiple languages.
notes.content:
Supported Simplified Chinese, German, Japanese, Spanish, Russian, Polish, Turkish, French, Italian, Dutch, Czech, Korean and Portuguese.

If you want to play the previous version of the game (ver 2.00 English only or ver 1.00), you can play by pressing [Properties] tab, [Beta] from STEAM application.

notes.title: Added the music
notes.content: We added music to the game.All music is original composition by us.

notes.title: BugFix
notes.content: Fixed a problem that sometimes the enemies are annihilated at the score ranking level.

notes.title: Added the STEAM global ranking board!!(and Level 5)
notes.content:
Verion 2.10
STEAM global ranking board and a level dedicated to score ranking (level 5) have been added!

notes.title: Huge update! It's almost a new game!
notes.content:
This game was updated to version 2.00!

The player's aircraft has been changed to the XF-97 prototype.
Four levels have been added.
The mobility of the player's aircraft has been upgraded.
The following aircrafts were added.
MQ - 9 (drone), F - 16, F - 15, Su - 27, AC - 130 (transport), and F - 15 Ace.
The previous game is now version 1.00, but you can play it. Right click the game name from the STEAM application and press Properties, Beta. You can now play 7 levels in all.

notes.title: About the next big update.
notes.content:
Dear customers

Based on the opinions from the players, we decided to rebuild this game from scratch.
It will be the world view of "SkyGameChanger - Air Combat II -".
There is a possibility that it will become completely different game by the next version upgrade.
The current game is planned to be as version 1.00.
From the STEAM application, you can play game version 1.00 by right-clicking the game name, selecting Properties, Beta.

Thank you.
